display_name: Services — Milk Dairy, Collection & Distribution Center
overview: Daily raw milk procurement from local cattle owners/farmers, chilling, fat/SNF testing, and morning/evening doorstep or booth delivery. Highly perishable inventory (daily turn), daily cash/UPI collections, fat/SNF testing pricing model, and bulk sales to sweet makers/cooperatives. Key factors are daily liter volume, refrigeration reliability, and timely payments to dairy farmers.
red_flags_json: Lack of reliable chilling equipment or power backup risking daily spoilage
Payment delays to supplying cattle farmers threatening milk supply continuity
Irregular delivery routes leading to customer attrition to organized dairy brands
Extreme seasonal fluctuation in milk supply without price buffer
